How would you differentiate a minor side character who happens to be gay from a "token" gay character? Why isn't a character's spouse considered a token spouse?

Well, first of all, "token spouses" aren't a thing because they are common. The point of token characters is that they are the minority forced into media to symbolize equality. So, things like token characters from underrepresented racial groups and token LGBT characters work, while "token straight character" won't work because it's generally a lot more common and not the minority.

Other than that, a specific character is considered a token because they fit within two criteria that define a token character; they are a minority, and there are only a few confirmed LGBT characters in that particular universe so far.

Hey everyone! Since launch there have been lots of new updates bringing new modes, requested features, improved quality of life features, and lots more. As we get into 2018 I wanted to share what my plans are for future updates for the game and what I have planned long term for the cooking simulation game!

#v1.6 Update & Future Expansions

---

In a few weeks v1.6 will be released that will bring some bug fixes, additional features and improvements to some of the interface. A lot of the new features is backend support that you won't see right away, such as getting the game ready for multiple languages and some UI improvements. All of this is in part to help me with getting the game prepped for console exports, the first of which will be a popular gaming console. The nice thing about getting the game console ready is that you all will be getting a lot of new and improved features as a benefit to getting the game on consoles, such as improved controller support, language packs, and more that I don't want to announce just yet.

What I will say is that I want to do a major expansion for PC that will coincide with the console release....more foods, new restaurants, more more more! I'll have news on that in the coming months. Of course, I have a few surprises up my sleeve too...but you'll just have to wait and see. 

#Coming Soon

---

An update after v1.6 will bring support for various controllers, rebuilt to be better supported in-game than it was in the previous version, as well as adding additional gamepads such as a popular alternative controller among others. I'm also looking into bringing Zen mode to all restaurants, not just the original game! 

Another feature that's been requested is bringing new co-op modes to the game. The standard dual chef mode will always be in the game, but I know a few of you would like the original chef/expediter mode from the previous version to be in the game, and again I have some ideas that I want to experiment with and see if I can add them in a future update.

I'll be back soon with v1.6! I want to thank everyone again for all the nice reviews and support, it's really meant so much to me! Thank you and keep cooking deliciously!
